guarantees.claim: tlram_gnt is asserted when tlram_req is high and tlram_we is low, otherwise deasserted.
tlram_rerror is permanently driven to all zeroes.

uncertain_points.claim: tlram_rerror is hardwired to 0; it is unclear whether the design intends to permanently suppress all read-error reporting or if error propagation was omitted unintentionally.
uncertain_points.risk: If the underlying read path can encounter errors (e.g., integrity violations), they would be silently masked, potentially leading to corrupted data being used without detection, which could affect security or functional safety.
